_readme: Every (categorySlug, legacyLabel) pair that exists in the database MUST appear
here with an explicit action. The backfill refuses to run on an unmapped label:
nothing is inferred, no slug is auto-suffixed, no legacy text is ever modified.
CREATE - make a managed Subcategory with the given name + slug and attach the article(s).
MERGE  - attach the article(s) to an EXISTING managed Subcategory with the given slug.
RETAIN - leave the article with its legacy label only. No managed assignment.
APPROVAL GATE: `approval.status` must be exactly "APPROVED", with approvedBy and
approvedAt filled in, before the backfill will write anything. Until then every
run is a dry run, by refusal rather than by convention.
